title: Happy hour
scene: After a long week Max's new colleagues invite him to happy hour at a bar. The bartender makes cocktails - a martini for one colleague and a gin and tonic with lime for Max - another colleague drinks a lite beer, and Anna does not drink alcohol at all.

old_story: After a long week, Max's new colleagues invite him to [[happy hour]]. They meet at a small [[bar]], and Anna comes too. The [[bartender]] is fast and friendly. He makes [[cocktails|cocktail]] for everyone. Oleh orders a [[martini]]. Max asks for a [[gin]] and [[tonic]] with [[lime]]. Iryna drinks a [[lite]] beer. Anna doesn't drink [[alcohol]], so she orders orange juice. By the end of the evening, Max knows everyone's name.

title: Quiz night at the pub
scene: Anna, Max and their friends play the Thursday quiz at an Irish pub. The barman brings ale and cider from a new keg, and between rounds they play darts and snooker.

words.ex: We go to a quiz night at the bar every Thursday.

old_story: Every Thursday there is a [[quiz]] at an Irish [[pub]] in town. Anna, Max and their friends make a team. The [[barman]] brings [[ale]] and [[cider]] from a new [[keg]]. Anna drinks tea and answers all the history questions. Between rounds, they play [[darts]]. Max misses the board every time. Then he plays [[snooker]] and wins easily. At the end, their team gets second place and a free pizza.

title: A new sweater
scene: Anna goes shopping at a big shopping center. She sees a sweater on a mannequin in the window; it is on sale, so she asks for the same model in blue cotton, gets a discount and pays in cash.

old_story: Anna loves [[shopping]]. Today she goes to a big [[shopping center]]. She needs a warm [[sweater]] for winter. In a shop window, she sees a [[mannequin]]. It wears a nice red one. It is on [[sale]]! Anna asks for the same [[model]] in blue. It is soft [[cotton]], not [[nylon]] or [[polyester]]. She also gets a student [[discount]]. She pays in [[cash]] and smiles.

title: Anna's student budget
scene: At the end of the month Anna counts her money: plus a hundred dollars from her parents, minus the money for books. She is on a tight budget and saves every cent and penny, so she goes to the bank, checks her balance, makes a deposit and decides not to buy anything on credit.

old_story: Today Anna counts her money. Her parents send her a hundred [[dollars|dollar]]. She has 50 more: 100 [[plus]] 50 is 150. Books cost 40, and 150 [[minus]] 40 is 110. Anna is on a tight [[budget]]. She saves every [[cent]] and every [[penny]]. On Monday she goes to the [[bank]]. She checks her [[balance]] and makes a [[deposit]]. Anna wants a new phone. But she does not buy it on [[credit]]. She saves for it instead.

title: Sofia's first fashion show
scene: Max's sister Sofia studies to be a fashion designer and shows her first collection at a fashion show. Supermodels wear her couture - a corset, a cape, jackets in cashmere, tweed, flannel and khaki - and she explains why she likes natural material and textile, not nylon or polyester.

old_story: Max's sister Sofia is studying to be a [[fashion designer]]. On Saturday she shows her first collection at a small [[fashion show]] in Kyiv. It isn't real [[couture]], but every piece is made by hand. A tall [[supermodel]] opens the show in a black [[corset]] and a long red [[cape]]. Next come soft jackets in [[cashmere]], [[tweed]] and [[flannel]]. The last model, dressed like a [[dandy]], wears a smart suit in [[khaki]]. After the show, Anna asks Sofia why she never uses nylon or polyester. Sofia smiles. "Natural [[material]] like wool feels better on the skin." "And good [[textiles|textile]] last for years," she adds. Her teacher says it is the best collection in the class.
